title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Coverage Definition: Covered Days Against Which Self-Pay Days Are Counted
content:
**Definition.** For the self-pay charge on a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental, the self-pay days are the rental days less the covered days, never below zero. The covered days of the self-pay charge depend on what stands on the reservation: where no repair notice stands and the days authorized, less any covered days already drawn, reach past the coverage end recorded on the reservation, they are those authorized days, but no more than the rental days; where a repair notice stands, they are the rental days that start on or before the latest notice date, but no more than the authorized days less any covered days drawn; otherwise they are the rental days that start on or before the recorded coverage end.

## Terms used

- **Days authorized**: the days of every covered-day authorization on the reservation, whoever pays them (insurer or network).
- **Covered days drawn**: the covered days already used at a settlement of the reservation.
- **Repair notice**: a vehicle-ready, repair-cancelled or total-loss notice received for the reservation; the latest notice date is the most recent of their dates.
- **Rental days starting on or before a date**: the whole days from the pickup date to that date, plus one, never more than all rental days.
- **Reach past the recorded coverage end**: the days authorized less the days drawn are more than the rental days starting on or before the recorded coverage end.

## Covered days table

| Repair notice stands | Authorized less drawn reach past the recorded coverage end | Covered days |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | Authorized less drawn, no more than the rental days |
| Yes | Either | Rental days starting on or before the latest notice date, no more than authorized less drawn |
| No | No | Rental days starting on or before the recorded coverage end |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, 12 rental days from a pickup on the 1st, coverage end recorded as the 8th)

- No notice; 10 days authorized, none drawn: 10 reach past the 8 days to the 8th, so 10 covered days and 2 self-pay days.
- A vehicle-ready notice dated the 6th; 10 days authorized: the 6 rental days starting on or before the 6th, so 6 covered days and 6 self-pay days.
- No notice; 7 days authorized: 7 do not reach past 8, so 8 covered days and 4 self-pay days.
